text:
Marco: Hi team, quick onboarding payroll question. I uploaded direct deposit but forgot to fill state withholding. I'm in NY and start Nov 3. How do I add the state tax form and when will it take effect? Also curious how holidays are handled for first partial month and where to submit mileage reimbursements.

Jade: Welcome Marco! :wave: For NY you'll need the IT-2104 in the HR portal under Tax Forms. Fill it out in the portal: Profile > Tax Forms > Add state form. Changes made before the payroll cutoff apply to the next run. PayrollBot can confirm cutoff times.

PayrollBot: Next payroll cutoff: 2025-11-21 17:00 ET. Next pay date: 2025-11-28. Tax form updates before cutoff are applied to next pay run.

PeopleOps: Holidays: we prorate paid holidays on your first partial month based on calendar days worked. PTO accrual starts pro-rated on your first full month. For mileage: use Expensify, select Reimbursement > Mileage, attach Google Maps screenshot and odometer start/end, tag with project code. Reimbursements processed within ~7 business days after approval.

Marco: Great — thanks. If I need to swap the deposit account before payday, do I just update the portal or email folks?

Jade: Update the portal and wait for "Verified" status. If it isn't updated before cutoff, email people-ops@redwood.inference and payroll@redwood.inference with your employee ID and the corrected account info.

Marco: Cheers, doing it now.
